disposition.change: Record the epic design sign-off for RWB-P3-E1019-DB so the story and its DOR item 14 cite the signed design.
disposition.note: No sign-off is in the story or the sources; the sign-off lives in the epic design record, which this story cannot create.
§12.8 states a database story uses no contract fake and is tested on an empty schema and a SIT copy; no fake library version is published, so item 22 does not apply.
§12.1 and §12.2 provide and consume no operation and §12.8 uses no fake; the version this story builds against is the V0001 baseline of rwb_case (§3, §13, DP-15).
MSG-GEN-001 row rewritten to the standard's meaning and text 'Enter {field}.' from Error and Message Standard v4 table 3 row 1; no new message ID is needed.
Guardrail amended: queue_member.user_id (DF-WRK-045 to DF-WRK-052) and queue.rr_cursor_user_id (DF-WRK-037) hold a user ID only, no name, contact or credential.
Both §14 rows aligned with Error and Message Standard v4 table 3: MSG-GEN-001 'Enter {field}.' (row 1), MSG-GEN-002 '{field} must be between {min} and {max}.' (row 2).
§2 now marks V019_1__queue_member.sql as the monolith name and number the service sequence does not reuse; §13 already assigns the V numbers at build time.
BR1 to BR8 each already cite a criterion in §8 and §16 covers AC1 to AC7 with TC-P3-E1019-DB-01 to -07; no new AC or test case row is needed.
